title: HMCL Online Feature Configuration v1
description: Default feature definitions and ordered regional overrides. Unknown fields are ignored except inside conditions.

features.description: Definitions keyed by case-sensitive feature identifiers. Missing or null means no definitions at this node. Absent features use the caller's default.

featureState.description: A boolean enabled state without a reason, or a complete feature definition.

localizedText.description: Optional explanation for a disabled feature. A string applies to every locale. A nonempty object maps language keys such as en, zh-Hans, or default to text. Missing or null means no explanation.

additionalProperties.description: Localized text. Numeric values are also accepted and converted to strings by the Gson reader.

overrides.description: Rules applied in depth-first array order. Each matching rule applies its features before its children; later siblings override earlier subtrees. Missing or null means no rules.

overrideRule.description: Replaces entire feature definitions, including any reason. This rule is evaluated only when all ancestor conditions match.

conditions.description: Matches any listed region, ignoring case. An unknown user region does not match. Unsupported condition fields are rejected.

regions.description: A nonempty array of nonblank region codes. Codes are not trimmed or restricted to a fixed list; duplicates are allowed.

items.description: Contains at least one character that is not whitespace according to Java String.isBlank().
